content.text: (abrasion, insect bite, IVDU), chronic edema, obesity, recent surgery
bacteria entry via minor skin injury
unilateral skin erythema, edema, warmth, & tenderness
, skin dimpling d/t surround edema (peau d’orange)
w/ localized SXS developing over a few days
MC bacterial skin infection in children
: poor personal hygiene, poverty, crowding, warm & humid weather, skin trauma
occurs at sites of superficial skin trauma
▪︎fever, diarrhea, rare (seen in newborns or younger children)
: ulcerative pyoderma that heals w/ scarring
▪︎bacitracin, retapamulin, wash skin w/ soap & water, good skin hygiene
